answer: Based on these articles, none of them tell customers to use a retired form. The only retired form mentioned is NW-POA-1, which was replaced by NW-POA-2 on February 1, 2026, and was accepted only until June 30, 2026. The co-owners article mentions NW-POA-1 only to explain that change and tells customers to use NW-POA-2. The other forms these articles direct customers to, NW-LRL-1 (lien release request) and NW-ODO-1 (odometer statement), are not described anywhere as retired.
